theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.gnwHookIdentity_proof (l : List ℕ) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (hpos : ∀ a ∈ l, 0 < a) (hne : l ≠ []) :
(List.map (fun (c : ℕ) => ↑(BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks l) / ↑(BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks (SYTEnum.removeCorner l c))) (SYTEnum.corners l)).sum = ↑(BraidKnot.IdentityI.sz l)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.gnw_noncorner_vanish (l : List ℕ) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (hpos : ∀ a ∈ l, 0 < a) (c : ℕ) (hc : c < l.length) (hnc : ¬SYTEnum.IsCorner l c) :
(betaNat l c * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.range l.length).erase c, (betaNat l c - 1 - betaNat l j)) / ∏ j ∈ (Finset.range l.length).erase c, (betaNat l c - betaNat l j) = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.gnw_corner_term (l : List ℕ) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (c : ℕ) (hcorner : SYTEnum.IsCorner l c) :
↑(BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks l) / ↑(BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks (SYTEnum.removeCorner l c)) = (betaNat l c * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.range l.length).erase c, (betaNat l c - 1 - betaNat l j)) / ∏ j ∈ (Finset.range l.length).erase c, (betaNat l c - betaNat l j)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.filter_map_sum (L : List ℕ) (p : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : ℕ → ℚ) :
(List.map f (List.filter (fun (x : ℕ) => decide (p x)) L)).sum = (List.map (fun (x : ℕ) => if p x then f x else 0) L).sum

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.list_range_sum (k : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℚ) :
(List.map g (List.range k)).sum = ∑ c ∈ Finset.range k, g c

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.betaLagrange_range (l : List ℕ) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (hk : 0 < l.length) :
∑ c ∈ Finset.range l.length, (betaNat l c * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.range l.length).erase c, (betaNat l c - 1 - betaNat l j)) / ∏ j ∈ (Finset.range l.length).erase c, (betaNat l c - betaNat l j) = ↑(BraidKnot.IdentityI.sz l)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.prod_betaNat_erase (l : List ℕ) (i : Fin l.length) (h : ℚ → ℚ) :
∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, h (betaVec l j) = ∏ j ∈ (Finset.range l.length).erase ↑i, h (betaNat l j)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.prodHooks_removeCorner (l : List ℕ) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (c : ℕ) (hcorner : SYTEnum.IsCorner l c) :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks (SYTEnum.removeCorner l c) = BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks (l.set c (l.getD c 0 - 1))

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.prodHooks_filter_zero_sorted (xs : List ℕ) :
List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) xs → BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks (List.filter (fun (x : ℕ) => x != 0) xs) = BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks xs

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.prodHooks_append_zero (m : List ℕ) :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks (m ++ [0]) = BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks m

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.colLen_append_zero (m : List ℕ) (j : ℕ) :
BraidKnot.IdentityI.colLen (m ++ [0]) j = BraidKnot.IdentityI.colLen m j

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.prodHooks_ratio (l : List ℕ) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (c : ℕ) (hcorner : SYTEnum.IsCorner l c) :
↑(BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks l) / ↑(BraidKnot.IdentityI.prodHooks (l.set c (l.getD c 0 - 1))) = betaNat l c * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.range l.length).erase c, (betaNat l c - 1 - betaNat l j) / (betaNat l c - betaNat l j)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.betaFactProd_pos (l : List ℕ) :
0 < SYTEnum.betaFactProd l

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.betaProdGap_ratio (l : List ℕ) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (c : ℕ) (hcorner : SYTEnum.IsCorner l c) :
↑(SYTEnum.betaProdGap (l.set c (l.getD c 0 - 1))) = ↑(SYTEnum.betaProdGap l) * ∏ j ∈ (Finset.range l.length).erase c, (betaNat l c - 1 - betaNat l j) / (betaNat l c - betaNat l j)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.gap_ratio_prod (l : List ℕ) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) (c : ℕ) (hc : c < l.length) (hpos : 1 ≤ l.getD c 0) :
∏ i ∈ Finset.range l.length, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioo i l.length, (betaNat (l.set c (l.getD c 0 - 1)) i - betaNat (l.set c (l.getD c 0 - 1)) j) / (betaNat l i - betaNat l j) = ∏ j ∈ (Finset.range l.length).erase c, (betaNat l c - 1 - betaNat l j) / (betaNat l c - betaNat l j)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.betaNat_ne (l : List ℕ) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i < j) (hj : j < l.length) :
betaNat l i - betaNat l j ≠ 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.betaNat_lt (l : List ℕ) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) {i j : ℕ} (hij : i < j) (hj : j < l.length) :
betaNat l j < betaNat l i

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.betaProdGap_cast_sigma (l : List ℕ) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) :
↑(SYTEnum.betaProdGap l) = ∏ p ∈ (Finset.range l.length).sigma fun (i : ℕ) => Finset.Ioo i l.length, (betaNat l p.fst - betaNat l p.snd)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.betaNat_set_self (l : List ℕ) (c : ℕ) (hc : c < l.length) (hpos : 1 ≤ l.getD c 0) :
betaNat (l.set c (l.getD c 0 - 1)) c = betaNat l c - 1

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.betaNat_set_ne (l : List ℕ) (c v : ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≠ c) :
betaNat (l.set c v) i = betaNat l i

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.betaNat_eq (l : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
betaNat l i = ↑(betaNatVal l i)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.betaProdGap_cast_pairs (l : List ℕ) (hl : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l) :
↑(SYTEnum.betaProdGap l) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range l.length, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioo i l.length, (betaNat l i - betaNat l j)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.row_range_eq_Ioo (l : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
∏ m ∈ Finset.range (l.length - 1 - i), (betaNat l i - betaNat l (i + 1 + m)) = ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioo i l.length, (betaNat l i - betaNat l j)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.betaFactProd_ratio (l : List ℕ) (c : ℕ) (hc : c < l.length) (hpos : 1 ≤ l.getD c 0) :
↑(SYTEnum.betaFactProd l) = ↑(betaNatVal l c) * ↑(SYTEnum.betaFactProd (l.set c (l.getD c 0 - 1)))

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.betaNatVal_set_self (l : List ℕ) (c : ℕ) (hc : c < l.length) (hpos : 1 ≤ l.getD c 0) :
betaNatVal (l.set c (l.getD c 0 - 1)) c = betaNatVal l c - 1

theorem QOU.Mathlib.SYTBetaLagrange.betaNatVal_set_ne (l : List ℕ) (c v : ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≠ c) :
betaNatVal (l.set c v) i = betaNatVal l i
